title: Beat the Heat
headline: Extreme heat. Cool down first, plan everything else around it.
quick: Drink water before you feel thirsty
Stay out of direct sun 11am to 4pm
notification: Heat alert: hydrate often and limit time in the sun today.

wear.top: Loose cotton or linen, light color
wear.shoes: Open, ventilated sandals or mesh sneakers

carry: Handheld fan or umbrella for shade

do: Sip 150-250 ml of water every 20 minutes when outside
Add electrolytes if you sweat heavily
Take cool showers and rest in shade or AC
Eat light meals like fruit, salad, yogurt
avoid: Leaving anyone in a parked car
watchFor: Hot, dry skin or confusion (heat stroke: seek urgent care)

travel: Park in shade and crack windows for airflow
Check tire pressure; heat raises it
home: Close curtains on sun-facing windows by 10am
Cook early or use no-cook meals
Run AC at 24-26C and use fans to spread the cool air

people.kids: Dress in light layers, offer water every 30 minutes, keep play indoors at midday.
people.elderly: Stay in cool rooms, check in by phone twice a day, avoid stairs and errands at noon.
people.pets: Walk before 8am, test pavement with your palm, always provide shade and water.
people.commuters: Carry water, avoid peak-sun waits, choose shaded routes.
people.athletes: Move sessions to dawn, cut intensity 20-30%, weigh before and after to track fluid loss.

rules.tip: Extreme heat: avoid outdoor work between 11am and 4pm.
High humidity blocks sweat cooling. Take extra rest breaks.
UV is very high: sunscreen, hat, and shade are essential.
Peak heat window. Shift outdoor plans to morning or evening.
Hot wind dries you out quickly. Drink more than usual.

commonMistakes: Waiting until you're thirsty to drink
Relying on cold sugary drinks to hydrate
